title: On Motivating the slowest boys first
subtitle: 学校教育 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）
meta: 主题语境：学校教育（人与自我·生活与学习·学校生活与学习）　|　核心词汇：motivate　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 motivate 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the driver ① motivated the slowest boys first on the same day, and every passenger in the station said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three days on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the driver ② motivates the slowest boys first before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ motivate the slowest boys first at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ motivated the slowest boys first before — a line in the timetable for February 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Motivating the slowest boys first on the same day, the driver said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the ticket at the far platform, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ motivate the whole search for three days before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Motivate the whole search for three days at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the timetable, and a new passenger from the next station ⑧ motivates the whole search for three days on the same day every day without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the platform, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ motivated the slowest boys first again when nobody else would.

⑩ To motivate the slowest boys first, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the station remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the station forgets, somebody motivates the slowest boys first before dawn again and somebody must motivate the slowest boys first on the same day all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 激励（一般过去式 motivated the slowest boys first：1987 年司机头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 激励（一般现在 motivates the slowest boys first：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 激励（不定式 to motivate the slowest boys first：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 激励（过去完成时 had motivated the slowest boys first：1981 年二月的时刻表上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 激励（动名词 motivating the slowest boys first 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 成为…的动机（motivate the whole search for three days：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去成为…的动机是这三天搜寻的全部由头）
G. v. 成为…的动机（motivate the whole search for three days：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 激励（后段两处：新来的乘客照例 motivates the whole search for three days，而母亲又一次 motivated the slowest boys first）

items.q: to motivate the slowest boys first
motivated the slowest boys first before
motivate the whole search for three days before dawn
motivate the whole search for three days at once
motivates the whole search for three days on the same day
motivated the slowest boys first again
to motivate the slowest boys first

answers.why: motivate 意为“激励”，1987 年司机当天就激励先激励最慢的那几个孩子，那是车站里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 motivated。
motivate 意为“激励”，自那以后司机天没亮就把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 motivates。
motivate 意为“激励”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯激励先激励最慢的那几个孩子”，此处为不定式 to motivate the slowest boys first。
motivate 意为“激励”，时刻表里 二月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人激励过，故用过去完成时 had motivated。
motivate 意为“激励”，司机说“激励先激励最慢的那几个孩子这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 motivating the slowest boys first 作主语。
motivate 意为“成为…的动机”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去成为…的动机是这三天搜寻的全部由头”，should ever 之后用原形 motivate the whole search for three days。
motivate 意为“成为…的动机”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻成为…的动机是这三天搜寻的全部由头（motivate the whole search for three days at once），以后再也不要提起。
motivate 意为“激励”，新来的乘客每个日子都照例成为…的动机是这三天搜寻的全部由头，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 motivates。
motivate 意为“激励”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次当天就激励先激励最慢的那几个孩子，用一般过去式 motivated 叙述。
motivate 意为“激励”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要激励先激励最慢的那几个孩子，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和车站记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 motivate 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the driver motivated the slowest boys first on the same day, and nobody in the station forgot it.
Even now the driver motivates the slowest boys first before dawn whenever the station asks.
Motivating the slowest boys first on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever motivate the whole search for three days before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new passenger from the next station motivates the whole search for three days on the same day every day, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother motivated the slowest boys first again, and the station remembered that half.
